findings.description: When the target already exists (duplicate upload), the function returns without removing the incoming temp file. Every duplicate put leaves a full-size `upload-<uuid>` file in `incoming/`, so disk usage grows without bound. The old code wrote nothing in this case.
findings.suggestion: Call `incoming.unlink(missing_ok=True)` before returning in the exists branch, or wrap the post-write steps in try/finally that unlinks the temp file.
findings.title: Temp upload file leaked when blob already exists

findings.description: The cleanup try/except only covers the write loop. If `_path_for`, `mkdir`, or `os.replace` raises (permissions, disk error), the temp file in `incoming/` is orphaned.
findings.suggestion: Extend the try/except (or use finally) to cover the digest computation, mkdir and os.replace, unlinking the temp file on failure.
findings.title: Failure after write leaves temp file behind
